original_test_intent: Determine whether total BMC memory and the relevant Redfish service memory remain stable throughout twelve hours of verified system idle, without management-service degradation.
original_method: Define idle state, metric, process identity, interval, and acceptance thresholds; securely collect timestamped total/free/available memory plus complete Redfish-process RSS/VMS/thread/command-line data for twelve hours; detect gaps and trends; correlate anomalies with BMC health, SEL, and service events; preserve raw data and end cleanly.
manual_activity: Owner defines idle, metrics, interval, and abnormal limits; operator monitors secure twelve-hour collection and anomalies; owner decides verdict.

safety_requirements: Never expose credentials or bypass host keys
Stop on BMC degradation or access loss
agent_execution_scope: Collect approved metrics for twelve hours
Make no threshold inference, BMC recovery decision, or DUT verdict
engineer_actions: Define metrics, idle state, interval, and thresholds
Disposition trend or collection gaps and issue PASS, FAIL, or BLOCKED

modernized_recommendation.status: APPROVAL-GATED TWELVE-HOUR BMC MEMORY TREND OBSERVATION
modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Collect a gap-audited time series with stable process identity and correlate trend changes to BMC events.

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: The source asks for a 12-hour observation but specifies only one top pipeline and undefined qualitative criteria, while also clearing logs. DeepSeek further introduces sshpass, host-key bypass, head truncation, and one-shot evidence.

engineering_decision_pending.question: Resolve Functionality row 2092 Wistron-BMC-01067-V002: define authoritative BMC DIMM and Redfish-process metrics, verified idle state, process identity, sampling interval, acceptable gaps, delta/slope/high-water limits, secure access, storage, time basis, health correlation, and recovery.

review_improvement: Preserves the twelve-hour idle objective while replacing a non-representative snapshot with auditable trend and service-health evidence.
independent_technical_reasoning: Memory stability is a temporal property: a leak can be invisible in one sample, while normal cache reclaim can look like a decrease. RSS must be tied to process start time or PID lifecycle because a Redfish restart resets the apparent trend. Total/free/available memory and complete process metrics distinguish process growth from kernel/cache behavior, while SEL and service logs explain discontinuities and management impact.
